summary: Murder (s.302 IPC), attempt to murder (s.307 IPC), destruction of evidence (s.201 IPC); death sentence confirmation appeal; ocular testimony of injured witness (PW-12) corroborated by circumstantial evidence including recovery of weapon/clothes under s.27 Evidence Act; prosecution case primarily rested on unrecorded 6-day delay in PW-12's statement but deemed insufficient to discard testimony; mitigating factors for reform considered against death penalty; Swamy Shraddananda precedent applied.
legal_provisions_cited: Swamy Shraddananda (2) v. State of Karnataka
final_judgment: Death sentence upheld; appeals dismissed; confirmation of death penalty maintained.
